The '''1998–99 Czech First League''', known as the [[Gambrinus (beer)|Gambrinus]] liga for sponsorship reasons, was the sixth season of top-tier [[association football|football]] in the [[Czech Republic]]. The season started on 2 August 1998.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.praguepost.com/archivescontent/28737-crosstown-rivals-await-big-kickoff.html|title=Crosstown rivals await big kickoff|work=Prague Post|date=29 July 1998|access-date=29 May 2013|archive-date=30 June 2013|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130630042621/http://www.praguepost.com/archivescontent/28737-crosstown-rivals-await-big-kickoff.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==League changes==

'''Relegated to the [[1998–99 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[SK Dynamo České Budějovice|České Budějovice]] ([[1997–98 Czech First League|15th]])
* [[AFK Atlantic Lázně Bohdaneč|Lázně Bohdaneč]] ([[1997–98 Czech First League|16th]])

'''Promoted from the [[1997–98 Czech 2. Liga]]'''
* [[FK Chmel Blšany|Blšany]] ([[1997–98 Czech 2. Liga|1st]])
* [[MFK Karviná|Karviná]] ([[1997–98 Czech 2. Liga|2nd]])
